Title: Ireland – Health services – Bespoke Panel Arrangement for the Provision of Children’s Residential Services to complement existing community based residential services operated by/on Behalf Of Tusla - The Child and Family Agency
Procedure title: Bespoke Panel Arrangement for the Provision of Children’s Residential Services to complement existing community based residential services operated by/on Behalf Of Tusla - The Child and Family Agency
Description: Tusla hereby invites suitably qualified and experienced Service Providers to submit tenders for the provision of Children’s Residential Services to complement existing community based residential services operated by/on behalf of Tusla. It is envisaged that all the required services of this tender will be funded and managed by Tusla. Please note that this tender was previously published on 09/03/2026 under the following eTenders Resource ID: 7641990 and OJEU Reference Number 2026- 162039 with the following title; Bespoke Panel Arrangement for the Provision of Children’s Residential Services to Complement Existing Community Based Residential Services Operated by/on Behalf of Tusla Following that competition a bespoke panel has been established and contracts have been awarded to successful tenderers. The purpose of this Contract Notice is to fulfil the obligations of the original bespoke panel competition by reopening the competition to interested parties as set out in Section 1.13 of the original Invitation to Tender. In that context, Service Providers that believe that they have the requisite capacity, suitability qualified staff, experience and expertise within their organisation to deliver the services required as outlined in the tender documentation, are invited to submit tenders for the provision of Children’s Residential Services to complement existing community based residential services operated by / on behalf of Tusla. Tusla now invites organisations to tender to join a Bespoke Panel Arrangement to provide high quality Children’s Residential Services. Requirements which arise under the Arrangement will be procured using spot purchasing. The Rates for services are set in the tender documents and interested parties applying to participate on the panel will be required to sign a declaration within the Tender Response Document. By signing the declaration, Applicants declaration confirms their agreement to these rates. It is envisaged that all the required services of this tender will be funded and managed by Tusla. This tender process is being conducted under Annex XIV of Procurement directives 2014/24/EU. The required services are listed as Annex XIV services, and accordingly, only Articles 74 to 77 of Directive 2014/24/EC applies to the award of any contract (s) that arise from this process.

Title: Germany – Electrical wiring and fitting work – L2v Gleichrichterwerk Julius-Brecht-Allee
Procedure title: L2v Gleichrichterwerk Julius-Brecht-Allee
Description: Neubau eines Gleichrichterwerks im BSAG-Netz im Bereich Julius-Brecht-Allee (Linie 2 verbindet).
Lot description: Im Rahmen des Infrastrukturprojekts "L2v - Linie 2 verbindet" plant die Bremer Straßenbahn AG die Herstellung eines neuen Gleichrichterwerks (GRW). Ein GRW ist ein Technikgebäude zur Einspeisung von Elektroenergie in das Bremer Straßenbahnnetz, sowie zur Überwachung und Steuerung der Bahnstromversorgung. Das neue Gleichrichterwerk wird im nördlichen Teil der Steubenstraße in 28211 Bremen erbaut. Die Fläche befindet sich nördlich der Eisenbahnüberführung Nord, über die die Eisenbahnstrecke 2200 (Bremen - Osnabrück) verkehrt. Westlich der Fläche des künftigen Gleichrichterwerks befindet sich ein Betriebshof des Amts für Straßen und Verkehr. Beim Neubau handelt sich um ein eingeschossiges Gebäude, bestehend aus einem Kriechkeller, dem Erdgeschoss und einem Flachdach. Im EG befinden sich die Schalt- und Technikräume. Die Bruttogrundfläche des UG beträgt ~96 m², mit einer lichten Raumhöhe von 1,4m. Die BGF im EG beträgt ca. 105 m² (ca. 6,00 x 16,00 m) mit einer lichten Raumhöhe von 3,20 m. Die Attikahöhe beträgt ~4,5 m über Gelände-Oberkante. Die Aufgabenstellung für dieses Gewerk besteht darin, den genannten Neubau mit der nötigen Elektrotechnik auszurüsten. Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie bitte aus dem Leistungsverzeichnis und der Baubeschreibung.
